name: Guitar Traveler
summary:
Guitar Traveler is a creative guitar studio in VR. Write your own songs, then play them yourself, one strum at a time. You don't need any music experience.

HOW IT WORKS
• Write on tab: poke the strings you want on each beat, right on the tab in front of your guitar.
• Add chords: drop chords onto the beat and shape them in a simple chord diagram, or pick one from the chord library.
• Strum to play: the song waits for you. Strum with your pick and play it at your own pace.
